ImageDescription.value: Slab with relief of queen Tiy-Merenese (and her cartouche), wife of pharaoh Sethnakht and mother of pharaoh Ramesses III. From Abydos, 20th dynasty (later reused) now in Cairo Museum (JE 36339).
